maddeler.e:
فننت (form I)
# فَنَنْتُ (fanantu) /fa.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of فَنَّ (fanna)
# فَنَنْتَ (fananta) /fa.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of فَنَّ (fanna)
# فَنَنْتِ (fananti) /fa.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of فَنَّ (fanna)
# فُنِنْتُ (funintu) /fu.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of فَنَّ (fanna)
# فُنِنْتَ (funinta) /fu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
